item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://cableteque.com/blog/losing-money-on-cable-assembly-quotes","version_id":"33abdbe4f75624efed189d40297ade0c2f12f250f578435d87954b3c34d4693e","decision":"accept","reason":"This is fresh, relevant commercial evidence about AI-assisted manufacturing quoting: Cableteque says its system reads customer drawings, builds a BOM, flags connector-compatibility gaps, compares distributor pricing, and fills portions of a labor template. The quoted Resco turnaround and backlog results are vendor/customer-reported claims, not independently verified evidence of performance; the relevant checks to seek are measured quote accuracy, missing-part detection against released builds, and time savings under disclosed workflows. It provides a quotable commercial perspective on where AI is being applied to design-for-manufacturing and estimating, while its claims should remain attributed to Cableteque and Resco.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
